xmldoc.short_description: Adjust timetable data to new row times.

param_input_item.param_description: New datetime or duration row times.
Named regular time step such as 'daily', 'hourly', or 'secondly'.
Fill, nearest-neighbor, interpolation, or aggregation method.

description.p: retime returns a timetable whose row times match newTimes or a regular time grid.
Supported fill and nearest-neighbor methods include fillwithmissing, fillwithconstant, nearest, previous, and next.
Supported numeric interpolation methods include linear, spline, pchip, and makima. Supported aggregation methods include sum, mean, min, max, median, prod, count, firstvalue, and lastvalue.
